Scarlet & Violet series · SVI

Scarlet & Violet

Released March 31, 2023 · 258 cards

StandardExpanded

Scarlet & Violet is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on March 31, 2023. Its main set has 198 cards, plus 60 secret rares numbered beyond the set (258 in total). It includes 209 Pokémon, 47 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

80 illustrators worked on Scarlet & Violet. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (14), 5ban Graphics (11), nagimiso (11), Tika Matsuno (10), kantaro (9), Studio Bora Inc. (9), Shin Nagasawa (7), Toyste Beach (7).
